claims.quote: Heterozygous variants in SLC6A1, encoding the GAT-1 GABA transporter, are associated with seizures, developmental delay, and autism.
The majority of affected individuals carry missense variants, many of which are recurrent germline de novo mutations, raising the possibility of gain-of-function or dominant-negative effects.

claims.object_text: in vitro GABA uptake assay for 213 unique variants
claims.quote: we performed an in vitro GABA uptake assay for 213 unique variants, including 24 control variants.
De novo variants consistently resulted in a decrease in GABA uptake, in keeping with haploinsufficiency underlying all neurodevelopmental phenotypes.
